regions.region: page 1 title, author block, summary, DOI, and keywords
regions.finding: The source title and aggregate Rh-catalyzed chirality-transfer claim were inspected. No SI association was inferred from the DOI or article metadata.

regions.region: page 1 Scheme 1a and 1b prior-work arrows
regions.finding: Toste/Mascareñas gold catalysis and Wender rhodium chemistry are explicitly prior work and are classified as literature examples with generic structures, not current-paper experiments.

regions.region: page 1 Scheme 1c and Table-1-linked prior result
regions.finding: The authors' previous RhCl(PPh3)3/toluene/40 °C/4.5 h result is the same condition as Table 1 entry 1 and is merged there. Scheme 1c gives 92% ee substrate while Table 1's header drawing gives 94% ee; both remain evidence-linked.

regions.region: page 1 Scheme 1d Trost arrows
regions.finding: Two distinct cited Trost substrate variants were retained as literature examples with their printed starting/product ee and yields.

regions.region: page 1 Scheme 1e This work and beginning of Scheme 2 discussion
regions.finding: The lower arrow is the generic current reaction class and is not assigned a table yield. The prose introduces six EATA allene preparations detailed on pages 2, 4, and 5.

unresolved: Prior-work generic structures and several catalyst details are not uniquely specified.
Scheme 1c versus Table 1 entry-1 starting-material ee conflict remains 92% versus 94%.
No Supporting Information file was associated.

regions.region: page 2 Scheme 2 EATA arrows and result lists
regions.finding: Six distinct optically active allene preparations (Ra-1a/1b/1c/1d and Sa-1b/1c) were linked to their detailed paragraphs rather than duplicated.

regions.region: page 2 dienol synthesis prose
regions.finding: The 2a LiAlH4 reduction was retained as one partial reported experiment. The HWE/DIBAL route to 2b–2d is a general two-step scheme with a collective 71–86% range that cannot be assigned row-wise.

regions.region: page 2 Scheme 3 NTs-tether allene-diene synthesis
regions.finding: Five Ra products and two Sa products are distinct Mitsunobu preparations. Detailed Ra-3a–3e procedures on pages 5–6 enrich the same records; Sa-3b/3h remain partial summary-level records.

regions.region: page 2 Scheme 4 malonate-tether synthesis
regions.finding: Separate 3f and 3g preparations were retained with the displayed multistage n-BuLi/MsCl/LiBr/NaH sequence; page 6 gives partial detailed context for 3f.

regions.region: page 2 Table 1 reaction header, entries 1–11, and footnotes a–e
regions.finding: All eleven optimization rows were retained separately with row catalyst/additive loading, solvent, time, isolated yield, ee, entry-1 temperature, entries-3/4/7 recoveries, entry-10 95% ee footnote, and entry-11 undried commercial ethanol footnote.

regions.region: page 2 Table 2 discussion and Scheme 5 introduction
regions.finding: The narrative introduces the seven Table 2 rows on page 3 and a proposed cyclometalation mechanism; no duplicate prose-only reactions were created.

unresolved: Individual 2b–2d yields and procedures are not stated.
Sa-3b/3h and several scheme-level preparations omit scale and operational details.
Table 1 entry 1 has conflicting 92%/94% starting ee evidence.

regions.region: page 3 Table 2 reaction header, entries 1–7, and footnotes
regions.finding: Seven independent substrate-scope experiments were retained with 0.5 mmol substrate, 3 mol% RhCl(PPh3)3, 5 mol% AgSbF6, dry EtOH 5 mL, row time, isolated yield, starting/product ee, and the entry-4 40 °C override.

regions.region: page 3 Figure 1 and adjacent absolute-configuration discussion
regions.finding: Figure 1 is ORTEP characterization of Table 2 product 4b, not a second synthesis and not machine-structure verification.

regions.region: page 3 Scheme 5
regions.finding: A/A'/B/C/D form a proposed catalytic cycle; the intermediates were classified as mechanism and not isolated experiments.

regions.region: page 3 Scheme 6 equations 1 and 2
regions.finding: Two distinct Sa-substrate experiments were retained: Sa-3b to enantiomeric 4b (80%, 94% ee) and Sa-3h to 4h (77%, 96% ee), with their separate 9 h and 5 h times.

regions.region: page 3 Figure 2 and conclusions
regions.finding: Figure 2 characterizes the Scheme 6 4b enantiomer; conclusions add no independent reaction or numerical outcome.

unresolved: Numerical diastereomer ratios, workups, purifications, isolated masses, atmospheres, and ee analytical bases are absent from the page-3 scope records.
X-ray images do not certify machine SMILES.

regions.region: page 4 conclusions continuation and Experimental general information
regions.finding: No new reaction appears in the conclusion. General information establishes oven-dried Schlenk tubes, solvent drying, activated 4 Å sieves, and oil-bath temperature convention; it is contextual rather than an experiment.

regions.region: page 4 left column detailed Ra-1a preparation
regions.finding: The Ra-1a EATA record retains exact auxiliary/CuBr2/propargyl tosylamide/pentanal/dioxane charges, argon, 130 °C/12 h, cooling, workup, chromatography, 1.1188 g/50%, and 97% ee.

regions.region: page 4 upper-right Typical Procedure A and Ra-1b preparation
regions.finding: The Ra-1b record retains sequential charging in a sealed tube, argon, 130 °C/8 h, workup, 1.4609 g/47%, and 92% ee. The heading prints Ra-1d while scheme/drawing/paragraph identify Ra-1b; the conflict is logged.

regions.region: page 4 lower-right Sa-1b preparation
regions.finding: A separate opposite-auxiliary experiment gives Sa-1b, 0.8489 g/54%, 93% ee after 130 °C/9 h; Typical Procedure A workup is linked rather than repeated as a new run.

unresolved: The Ra-1b section-heading label conflict remains unresolved.
HPLC supports ee values but does not verify machine structures.

regions.region: page 5 left column Ra-1c and Sa-1c preparations
regions.finding: Two distinct auxiliary enantiomer experiments were retained with exact charges, 130 °C/11 h or 10.5 h, Typical Procedure A workup, 1.0850 g/71% and 1.0750 g/70%, both 99% ee.

regions.region: page 5 lower-left Ra-1d preparation
regions.finding: The malonate-allene preparation retains exact charges, 130 °C/12 h, chromatography, 1.2102 g/50%, and 97% ee. Heading/drawing show Ra-1d while the paragraph prints Sa-1d; both statements are preserved.

regions.region: page 5 upper-right Ra-3a preparation
regions.finding: The Mitsunobu record has separate 0 °C DIAD addition (2 min), 0 °C hold (2 min), natural warming with missing duration, 17.5 h room-temperature hold, all THF portions, chromatography, 1.3041 g/70%, and 97% ee.

regions.region: page 5 lower-right beginning of Typical Procedure B / Ra-3b
regions.finding: The Ra-3b preparation begins with exact 0 °C charges and three THF carrier volumes, then natural warming and a 20 h room-temperature hold; characterization continues on page 6 within the same record.

unresolved: Natural warming durations are not stated.
Ra-1d has an unresolved Ra/Sa label conflict.

regions.region: page 6 upper-left continuation of Ra-3b characterization
regions.finding: Completes the same Ra-3b preparation with 0.3280 g/44%, 97% ee and 20:1 chromatography; no duplicate record was created.

regions.region: page 6 left column detailed Ra-3c and Ra-3d preparations
regions.finding: Two distinct Typical Procedure B experiments retain exact PPh3/allene/dienol/DIAD/THF charges, 16 h or 41 h room-temperature holds, chromatography, 0.4557 g/59%/93% ee and 0.3316 g/39%/98% ee.

regions.region: page 6 upper-right detailed Ra-3e preparation
regions.finding: The Ra-3e experiment retains exact charges, 23.8 h at room temperature, chromatography, 0.3667 g/63%, and 98% ee.

regions.region: page 6 lower-right Scheme and beginning of Typical Procedure C for Ra-3f
regions.finding: The multistage record separately represents -78 °C n-BuLi addition/hold, MsCl hold, LiBr hold, warming to room temperature, separate 0 °C NaH deprotonation, combination, second warming, and 9 h room-temperature alkylation. The detailed paragraph continues beyond page 6; later-page mass/workup/purification were not imported.

unresolved: Both warming-transition durations in Typical Procedure C are unreported.
The Ra-3f paragraph continues beyond page 6; exact second-vessel charges, workup, purification, and isolated mass remain missing in this session.
Ra-3g is only scheme-level on pages 1–6.
